facts.fact: 2007 年夏，新斯科舍像一排断牙从大西洋里被巨口顶出来，埃莉第一眼就讨厌它
facts.anchor: Nova Scotia rose up from the Atlantic as if it were a clot of broken teeth, forced from the maw of a giant mouth.

facts.fact: 母亲说这次安置最多两个月，等她在硅谷安顿好就来接她
facts.anchor: It was only supposed to be temporary.

facts.fact: 之后的四个月里母亲的信越来越少、再婚生子，却始终没叫她过去
facts.anchor: But she never asked me to come.

facts.fact: 祖母 June 说 Eleanor 太长，退潮时在浅滩间喊不动，改叫她 Ellie
facts.anchor: She said Eleanor was too long, not easily shouted over the crashing waves when we were out searching the shoals at low tide.

facts.fact: 住满一年后她给房间刷了奶油黄墙漆、从此改口自称 Nana
facts.anchor: After a whole year at Grandma June’s, she let me paint the walls of my room a warm buttercream yellow, and insisted I call her simply Nana.

facts.fact: 十二岁生日后那个秋夜，风暴里她听见金属刮擦岩石的刺耳声，以为是船触礁
facts.anchor: The grating, grinding wheeze of metal on rock. Of a ship coming aground, its bow tearing apart against the shallow boulders just off the cape.

facts.fact: 雨里她划着小艇出去，看见的不是搁浅的渔船，而是一座完整的岛
她在岛上只待了几个小时，回来后警察告诉她已经整整失踪一周
facts.anchor: that I had been missing for a whole week.
